text.en: The missing line decides when the PWM output is on: it should be high as long as the counter has not yet reached the duty value, and low after that.
text.es: La línea que falta decide cuándo la salida PWM está encendida: debe estar alta mientras el contador aún no alcanza el valor de `duty`, y baja a partir de ahí.

text.en: Use one conditional concurrent assignment (`'1' when … else '0'`) that compares `count` against `duty`, converting the port with `unsigned(duty)` so both sides are the same type.
text.es: Usa una asignación concurrente condicional (`'1' when … else '0'`) que compare `count` con `duty`, convirtiendo el puerto con `unsigned(duty)` para que ambos lados sean del mismo tipo.

text.en:
Compare the counter against the duty value directly.
```vhdl
pwm_out <= '1' when count < unsigned(duty) else '0';
```
text.es:
Compara el contador con el valor de `duty` directamente.
```vhdl
pwm_out <= '1' when count < unsigned(duty) else '0';
```
